changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[FusionQuery_All] AS select A.ID as FusionQueryAttributeID, F.ID as ConfigurationID, F.Name as [Configuration], A.FusionQueryAttributeTypeID, FAT.Name as FusionQueryAttributeType, F.FusionTypeID, FT.Name as FusionType from FusionQueryAttribute A inner join FusionQueryAttributeType FAT on FAT.ID = A.FusionQueryAttributeTypeID inner join Fusion F on F.ID = FAT.FusionID inner join FusionType FT on FT.ID = F.FusionTypeID
